evidence: In the ALD of SP, tetrakis(dimethylamino)tin (TDMASn, Air Liquide) and trimethyl phosphate (TMPO, Acros) were used as the Sn and P precursors, while H2O and ozone were used to oxidize the Sn and P precursors, respectively. Dry nitrogen (99.999%) was used as the transport and purge gas with a flow rate of 1.5 sccm.
